title: MACH Factory Intake Ledger v1
description: The Factory's record of approved product work it has taken in: .factory/intake/ledger.json, git-ignored and machine-local. It maps each slice revision to its execution ticket. Whether work is active or integrated is never stored as fact here; it is read from the cells and from Git each time.

source.description: The integration branch and commit of the last intake.

intakes.description: Keyed by project/wave/content digest: each distinct approved wave content is taken in once.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the work order, the why and the spec: the identity of this slice revision.

pending_ticket.description: True from the moment a ticket is wanted until one is recorded; an interrupted intake finishes from here.

integrated.description: Set once the slice's commit was verified on the integration branch.

built_against.description: The revision of each dependency when this slice was dispatched.

history.description: Earlier revisions and tickets of this slice.

owner.description: Who moves a dispatched ticket through the line. The supervisor runs only its own.

pending_events.description: Events not yet appended to events.jsonl. Part of the ledger until they are in the log.

supervisor.description: The supervisor's own record, kept here so claims and intake share one lock and one order of events. It says what the supervisor did, never where a ticket stands: that is read from the cell.

executions.description: One entry per claimed execution, by execution ID.

provenance.description: M6.5. What the execution was started with, captured once after authorization and before launch (skills/run/scripts/provenance.py): digests, versions, identifiers, numbers and booleans only. The same object is on its execution.started event. Null, with provenance_reason capture-failed, when it could not be taken; absent on executions from before M6.5. Never recomputed.

state.description: claimed: reserved on disk, nothing started. started: its process was launched. finished: it ended and left a result. unknown: it is gone and left none. released: the claim was given back before anything ran.

attempts.description: Per ticket: executions that ended without moving it.

parked.description: Tickets taken out of automatic execution until a person resumes them, each with the reason.

observed.description: The last stage seen for each ticket, to report a change once.
